title: An excluded archive entry remains available to the next Gradle layer
summary: The original Gradle builds assign Open and Hidden to opposite layers under an exclusion. The merge also keeps Hidden out of the first layer when a broader include matches it.

change.description: An excluded archive entry remains available to the next Gradle layer

notes: The consumer expands directory rules from the packaged layers.idx and rejects a missing entry, duplicate owner or changed class bytes.
